test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No improvement required’.

The annual seed festival hosted in Auroville __promote sharing of traditional__ knowledge and sustainable farming practices.
solution: The correct answer is **Option 3)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"promote"** means to support or actively encourage something; to advance or raise to a higher position or rank. (बढ़ावा देना) • **Example: **The government aims to **promote **tourism in the rural areas. • **"Traditional" **refers to something that is based on customs, beliefs, or methods that have existed for a long time without changing. (पारंपरिक) • **Example: **The festival celebrates **traditional **music and dance forms. Hence, we can infer that the correct phrase is **'promotes sharing of traditional'** to make the sentence grammatically **correct and meaningful.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: promotes sharing of tradition** (परंपरा का साझा करना बढ़ावा देता है): This phrase is not grammatically correct as "tradition" is a noun and does not fit well in the context. • **Example:** This sentence is incorrect: The event promotes sharing of tradition. • **Option 2: promotes sharing of traditionally** (पारंपरिक रूप से साझा करने को बढ़ावा देता है): The adverb "traditionally" does not fit correctly in this context. • **Example: **This sentence is incorrect: The event promotes sharing of traditionally. • **Option 4: No improvement required** (कोई सुधार आवश्यक नहीं है): This option is incorrect because the original sentence is grammatically incorrect. • **Example:** The original sentence is incorrect: The annual seed festival hosted in Auroville promote sharing of traditional knowledge and sustainable farming practices. 53:Tc5d, The correct answer is **Option 3)**
